text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Stand up! In the center of the stage once more!
I want to, toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm just ordinary, I want to win today of all days!
Even if the distance is too shooort~~~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!!
Hear ye, those from afar!!
Draw near and behold, those who are close!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The one who's gonna flip this era upside down
is MEEEEEEEE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They clash again and again, trading fierce bursts of closing speed.
And then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winner is――No Reason!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Take thaaaaat!!
Victory in this realm-dividing battle is miiiiine!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As if I could ever comprehend destiny!!
These hands will surely reach the heavens!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"The next one to rule the world
will be MEEEEEE!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Roars of screams and cheers.
Listening to that thunderous bellow—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: U-U-Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!! Waaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Kh, uuugh...
Khhhuuuugh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Unable to grasp victory,
Hishi Miracle and Dantsu Flame wept."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako, Dantsu.
Both of your runs were... magnificent as well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit was palpable.
And yet... why on earth is she weeping?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Those hardly look like tears of celebration for my victory, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, I'm frustrated...
but I'm also happy I gave it my all...
And then...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Part of me wants to say congrats to No Reason-chan,
but I'm also just so frustrated~..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if that was my best run yet...
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I think this might be... the first time...
I've ever dug so deep and squeezed out every last drop of strength...
That's why... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those were tears laced with a multitude of emotions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of unmistakably giving it her all,
something deep within her heart seemed to have been stirred.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I see. But it is far too early to lose yourself in sentiment.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This race is merely the beginning of our grand uprising.
We must save the greatest thrills for later!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Kris S! Lord Tap!
Lord Universe!
And all the rest of you, until we meet again!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
After the Spring Campaign comes the Autumn Campaign!
And after that, my era will finally begin, I tell ye—!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha!
Today was simply the best, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yossahoi, yossahoi!
Yossahoi-hoi♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come on, drink and dance!
It's just the two of us now.
Drink, drink, drink it down~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason offered me a cola.
Lately, she's let her guard down around me
to an incredible degree whenever we're alone.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. On to the next one.
First, we need to set our sights on our autumn goals.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the battle to decide the best in Japan, it has to be the Japan Cup!
However, if we were to run before that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With No Reason's current strength, she no longer needs a prep race. If that's the case—
choice_data_list: Let's bring our all to the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, the "Tenno Sho (Autumn)".
I knew you would choose that. Truly, great minds think alike.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A premier 2,000m GⅠ representing autumn!
Right after the start lies a tricky section cutting sharply inward, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
For me right now,
such a fierce battlefield is just right!
I will conquer it brilliantly, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!
To think my realm is without a single flaw!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Late spring.
No Reason was truly
basking in the prime of her life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heading toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn), her dominance seemed to grow even greater.
